Artificial Grass Installation in the Blue Mountains

Premium artificial grass, professionally installed — a green, usable, no-mow lawn all year, perfect for shaded, sloping or high-traffic areas where real turf struggles.

Some Mountains blocks are just hard on lawns — deep shade, heavy wear, slopes or frost. Premium artificial grass gives you a clean, green lawn every day of the year, with none of the mowing, watering or muddy patches.

We prepare a proper compacted base with drainage, then install quality synthetic turf that looks and feels natural and stays put through the seasons.

What’s included

  • Premium synthetic turf supply and install
  • Compacted base with proper drainage
  • Great for shade, slopes and high-wear areas
  • Pet- and kid-friendly options
  • Clean edges and secure fixing
  • No mowing or watering

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.

Questions

Blue Mountains landscaping, answered.

Do you cover the whole Blue Mountains?

Yes — from the lower Mountains at Glenbrook and Blaxland through Springwood and Faulconbridge up to Katoomba, Leura and Blackheath. Tell us your suburb and we'll confirm.

How much does landscaping cost up here?

Every block is different, so we quote each job on its own and give you a clear, fixed written quote before any work starts.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes — we hold the appropriate licences and public liability insurance, and we're happy to provide details with your quote.

Do you handle steep and bushfire-prone blocks?

Absolutely. We build retaining and drainage to suit the slope and can plan gardens with bushfire and APZ considerations in mind.
